capabilities: Export notes as XML or Markdown
Export notes based on tags or properties
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer for full functionality.
intentEvidence: Smart Export turns one Obsidian note into a clean exportable context bundle by following wikilinks to a configurable depth.
problem: Users often need to manually gather and stitch together related notes into a single, readable context bundle for printing or LLM workflows.
summary: Smart Export bundles related notes and their linked context into a single, structured file for export, supporting various formats like XML and LLM-ready Markdown.
